description: This is a shell script used for testing Git diff commands and their output under various scenarios, including diff options, outside repository files, and file content changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success if the command executes correctly.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks if the executed command returns the expected exit code.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in a given file or output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test-tool
methods.description: A utility within the test framework (e.g., chmtime) used to modify file timestamps.
